what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Romania, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, IDMC recorded 246 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Romania, so it does not say why people were displaced by violence.
IDMC's disaster records for Romania list floods.

when.text: IDMC's data for Romania starts in 2008.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC also recorded 1325 new displacements by disasters, again counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Romania.
